content: For Svelte 5 desktop time-series charts, uPlot (~45-48KB min, canvas-based, framework-agnostic) is the leanest performant option; LayerCake is a Svelte-native scales/SVG composition framework (no bundled chart types, build-your-own) also very lean; Chart.js (~250KB) and D3 (85-320KB) are heavier full-featured alternatives.
